title: Mirror JMAP-ic0j.28 in chat-server: MemoryBackend::*_for_test pub methods diverge from canonical mail-server
description:
Companion to bd:JMAP-ic0j.28, applied to chat-server.

`crate-jmap-chat-server/src/memory.rs` exposes four `pub fn *_for_test` methods on its `MemoryBackend`:

- `set_retains_edit_history_for_test(&self, retain: bool)` (line 251)
- `set_protect_last_admin_for_test(&self, value: bool)` (line 270)
- `set_limits_for_test(&self, limits: Option<ChatLimits>)` (line 352)
- `insert_object_for_test(&self, type_name, account_id, id, value)` (line 367)

Unlike the calendars-server analogues handled by bd:JMAP-ic0j.28 (which had zero callers and were simply deleted), chat-server's `*_for_test` methods ARE called by integration tests across:

- `crate-jmap-chat-server/tests/space_metadata_apply.rs`
- `crate-jmap-chat-server/tests/space_set_kitchen_sink.rs`
- `crate-jmap-chat-server/tests/role_member_apply.rs` (uses `set_protect_last_admin_for_test`)
- `crate-jmap-chat-server/tests/channel_category_apply.rs`
- `crate-jmap-chat-server/tests/integration.rs`
- ... and several other test files.

The canonical `jmap-mail-server` exposes zero `*_for_test` mutation knobs from its `MemoryBackend` — its test seams live in `tests/common/mod.rs` (e.g. `FaultyBackend` wrapper). Per workspace AGENTS.md "Canonical Templates", chat-server diverges and needs migration:

Two coherent paths:

  (a) Move the mutation knobs out of `MemoryBackend`'s public API: gate them behind `#[cfg(test)]` or `pub(crate)`, and re-expose to integration tests via a wrapper in `crate-jmap-chat-server/tests/common/mod.rs`. Requires touching every integration test that uses these.

  (b) Keep the helpers `pub` under `memory` but rename to drop the `_for_test` suffix and document `MemoryBackend` as a demonstration backend whose mutation knobs are part of its supported API surface. The "MemoryBackend is reference impl, not production" framing makes this honest. No call-site changes needed; the new names propagate by find-and-replace.

Out of scope for bd:JMAP-ic0j.28 because that bead's calendars-server analogues had zero callers and the workspace did not need to settle the deeper "what is `MemoryBackend`?" question to resolve them. This bead forces the question.

P3 — pre-1.0, no SemVer lock yet, but the more chat-server's integration tests grow the more painful path (a) becomes. File now to capture the decision before the surface area grows further.
notes: DECISION Mark 2026-10-22: option (a) via a 'test-helpers' cargo feature: move the pub *_for_test MemoryBackend knobs (chat-server memory.rs 11 sites; calendars-server lib.rs:513,:521; scene-server memory.rs:507; vtc-server memory.rs:420,:426,:433) behind #[cfg(feature = "test-helpers")]; integration tests enable it via the crate's self dev-dependency (see RELEASING.md blocker 1, bd:JMAP-31o4, for the self-dev-dep publish caveat). Same pattern in every crate that has such knobs; mail-server has none.
